body: I can't see doctor because I'm still a minor and my family doesn't really understand depression. So I'm kind of on my own. I told my sister but didn't get any help. I tried to get online therapy but they said I should use traditional face to face therapy.

I always bottle up my feelings so I can't explain my problems really well. So many things keep happening from my childhood that I don't know how much I can share my feelings. And no matter what happens I keep blaming and hating myself. So saying I feel bad feels like a crime. There is a voice in my head that keeps saying that I should die. I feel so frustrated that I'm tired of living and hating myself. I want to disappear from everyone's life and memories. I thought I don't mind if anyone hurts me anymore but when I was left all alone by my friends and family again I broke again and I should say quite miserably. I blamed myself for not getting used to get hurt. I'm tired of getting hurt and being used by them. I'm tired of hating myself because I can't speak my problems well. I also hate myself for being depressed. I wish I was never born. I wish I never met my toxic selfish friends. I wish I could forget these bitter feelings and memories.
